scope: Source/theory only. No new payload, model, teacher, fitting, measurement or simulation; no release.
verdict: Useful challenges; no closed analytic certificate vetoes the prospective C64 necessary-quality stage.
claim_filter: C8 and NL8 each satisfying their own bounded partial-development screen does not prove quality equivalence, statistical indistinguishability, C-versus-NL dominance or complete routed coverage.

The asserted NL>=9.80GB and cache deficit rely on an unclosed compulsory nonrouted floor. They are not inclusive capacity proofs or proofs against hybrid/cache NL. Every total host budget must deduct P/tree/scales/bias, non-FFN/shared/fallback weights, KV, runtime and peak workspace before assigning a map cache.

96.96us is a lower bound for one specified serial two-wave construction, not all AiF. Comparing it with resident EPYC C service153-211us supplies neither a feasible ordinary-miss upper bound nor a narrow-window theorem. The pinned eight workers share two32MiB L3 groups; an aggregate512MiB machine-cache claim does not describe their shared working set.
Untouched operators execute source GGUF, not a globally canonical exact model. Small intervention-slot fractions do not bound quality loss or whole-DAG time.
Nonfinite fitting is technical-invalid and stops. Support follows the frozen all-x rule; zero natural route hits do not justify fallback.

Free-generation32 and replacing all42 routed layers are useful possible later scopes, not universal prerequisites for this necessary GT stage or publication iff rules. Adequate nontrivial coverage, E2E evidence and matched strong controls remain required.

A finite peak-liveness ledger and per-expert/chunk scratch suffice for resource control; a blanket prediction-cache ban is unnecessary. Removing raw GU caches can require extra FMA passes for bias/Down calibration, which must be charged with the same sequential calibration order.

finite_miss_ledger.definition: K is6 or8; m is demanded map misses after identical legal cache/prefetch state, h=K-m. Remaining bytes already in flight must not be charged twice. Compare the same bank, copies, addresses and available information.
finite_miss_ledger.legal_domain: For K6 ignore m7 andm8. Wave counts require four complete g4-group copies and legal placement/addresses. One-copy waves equal the maximum group occupancy and can reachK; this is not a universal ceil(m/4) guarantee.
finite_miss_ledger.extra_work: Ordinary load additionally moves missing metadata. PE additionally sends128 input bytes per participating chip, up to512m bytes without proven broadcast, plus descriptors/status/ECC/drain and host conversion. Both pay shared P/tree once where applicable, CPU hits, output bias/alpha/combination and real core/BW contention. Host canonical cache copies need not duplicate flash replicas.
finite_miss_ledger.same_policy_m0: The defined CPU-hit-only policy is identical on both systems when m0. A hardware design may also offer compute offload or ordinary-load fallback; neither comparison should force resident hits through NAND.
finite_miss_ledger.feasible_loader_upper_template: Given an actually feasible asynchronous service envelope R_load(m), sufficient charged workspace and reserved resources, a conservative schedule is address_ready + max(P_service+CPU_hit_service, R_load(m)) + CPU_miss_GEMV_service + combine_service. A serial loader schedule is an alternative feasible upper. Peak bandwidth division alone instantiates neither upper.
finite_miss_ledger.PE_envelope_requirement: Use actual sense/setup/input/ECC/PE/output/finish envelopes for each occupied wave, single-context lifetimes, FIFO credit and serial ownership. Schedule CPU hits on the same finite cores/BW. Early sense/read before P must be granted to both paths when addresses are ready.
finite_miss_ledger.capacity_rule: M_cache=M_total-M_aux-M_peak_workspace, under each actually deployed representation. Full replicas, original fallback, ECC/reserves and control storage are charged; nominal LSB capacity is not free usable capacity.

zero_payload_gate.genuine_falsifiers: A proven shape/port/lifetime/capacity contradiction, or a validated feasible ordinary-baseline upper no worse than a valid optimistic bound for every allowed PE-using miss/placement/cache policy in the bounded design, with CPU-hit/fallback alternatives and uncertainty included.
zero_payload_gate.current_status: No such dominance certificate is supplied. Missing PE/ECC/FIFO/PPA service evidence is unresolved feasibility, not an achieved benefit or a fabricated quality failure.
zero_payload_gate.conditional_window: For missful cases PE changes262144 weight bytes into8192 result bytes per expert before auxiliary traffic. That32x payload distinction and legal P overlap leave a conditional opportunity. Arithmetic traffic reductions alone do not establish latency, native necessity or>=10% E2E gain.

finite_strong_control.choice: Freeze one E64 SO64_pre transfer of the existing q512/W8/normalP128/C32/identity recipe before fresh outcomes; defer fitting/evaluation to a separate release, without a new grid.
finite_strong_control.why_material: Shared final lift changes necessary work. Leading products are K*q*r+H*q:1441792 atK6 and1572864 atK8, versus C's K*H*r:1572864 and2097152. Its all64 layer bank is about156246016 bytes before common geometry/fallback, versus C's map/scales/bias about570425344 bytes. These are arithmetic/storage counts, not quality or timing dominance.
finite_strong_control.numeric_caveat: Actual-alpha F32 latent premerge changes rounding and requires a weighted-slot hook; never divide by alpha. The current two-expert SO8 basis is not evidence for all64 output-subspace quality. One fixed recipe also does not exhaust nonlinear MoLAE-style controls.

disposition: Proceed only through prospective fixed C64 protocol/source gates; preserve old8 artifacts and reserve fresh evaluation bodies. Strong controls and whole-DAG/cache/native feasibility remain open, with no automatic experiment release.
